summary: Implemented private attachment storage with local and Aliyun OSS drivers, unified upload validation, signed read URLs with issuance/download auditing, sensitive-material grants, and configurable retention that purges objects plus structured records.
command: npm run typecheck --prefix backend; npm run lint --prefix backend; npm test --prefix backend; npx prisma validate; npx prisma migrate deploy on a temporary MySQL database talentflow_ats005; npx nest build with a temporary no-delete output directory; node smoke-ats005.mjs against a temporary API instance on port 3111 (23 HTTP checks).
scope: docs/ats-项目目标与实施路线图-v1.0.md

checks.name: unified_upload_validation
criteria: 统一上传校验类型、大小和内容；OSS 私有读及短期签名链接校验有效期和访问权限。
checks.details: Extension, declared MIME and magic bytes must agree before storage; rejected files persist an intake row with errorCode. Unit tests cover PDF/DOC/DOCX/PNG/JPEG/WEBP, empty, oversize, unsupported, MIME mismatch and content mismatch. HTTP smoke returned CONTENT_MISMATCH, MIME_MISMATCH and UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT for fake inputs.

checks.name: private_storage_and_signed_read
criteria: 统一上传校验类型、大小和内容；OSS 私有读及短期签名链接校验有效期和访问权限。
checks.details: Objects stored under resumes/<sha256><ext> outside Git; GET /attachments/:id/read-url returned a local-driver URL bound to key, expiry (120s in smoke) and actor. Tampered signature, replaced actor and expired link all returned 403; the valid link served application/pdf with Cache-Control private, no-store.

checks.name: access_control_and_sensitive_material
criteria: 敏感材料访问留痕，到期清理覆盖文件与结构化记录；保留期限配置化并在上线前确认。
checks.details: A second RECRUITER user outside the intake data scope received 404 for the attachment; marking the file BANK_STATEMENTS made issuance return 403 until a read field grant existed, then 200. Audit actions attachment.read_url_issued, attachment.downloaded and retention.purge were all present in audit_logs.

checks.name: retention_lifecycle
criteria: 敏感材料访问留痕，到期清理覆盖文件与结构化记录；保留期限配置化并在上线前确认。
checks.details: GET /retention/policy exposed configurable days. Dry run reported expired=1 with deletedFiles=0 and left the row intact; the real purge deleted the object file, removed the resume_files row, detached resume_intakes.resumeFileId, wrote retention_runs, timeline attachment.purged and audit retention.purge. Object delete failure keeps the structured record for retry (unit test).

checks.name: quality_gates
criteria: 统一上传校验类型、大小和内容；OSS 私有读及短期签名链接校验有效期和访问权限。
checks.details: Prisma schema valid; all migrations applied to a fresh MySQL database; backend typecheck and oxlint (77 files, 0 warnings) passed; 78 unit tests passed (23 new); nest build with a temporary no-delete output directory emitted retention.runner.js and attachments controller.

limitations: The Aliyun OSS driver was not exercised against a real bucket because no test credentials are available; only the local disk driver was verified end to end.

npm run build (nest build with deleteOutDir) fails on this Windows machine because the trash/safe-delete guard cannot remove dist while a dev watcher holds it; the build was verified with an equivalent nest build configuration writing to a temporary output directory.
Retention defaults (365 days for resumes, 180 days for background/bank materials) still require business confirmation before go-live.
Frontend attachment entry and preview remain in ATS-008 scope; only backend contracts and the local signed download were verified.

Temporary verification artifacts (dist-check, dist-verify, backend/.storage-verify) could not be removed because the environment safe-delete guard rejected the deletion; they are untracked and excluded from the commit.
